_notes: One entry per planet type (PlanetFrame), not per planet. Planets themselves are generated from seeds by planets/plangen.c, calc.c and gentopo.c.
quantity_class: FEW, MODERATE or NUMEROUS (see constants); quality_class: LIGHT, MEDIUM or HEAVY. Packed as the low and high nibble of ELEMENT_ENTRY.Density.

useful_elements lists the used slots of UsefulElements (8 in UQM). The unused slots (NOTHING, no deposit) are always the last ones, so the 8 slots are the list padded with empty ones; mineral generation draws a random number for every slot, empty or not.
density_class and atmosphere_class are the low and high nibble of PlanetFrame.AtmoAndDensity.
color_map_resource and color_table_resource are content resource ids (planet graphics), resolved by the client.

battle_sprites are the content resource ids of the planet in a battle, big, medium and small, as load_gravity_well (cons_res.c) names them; shielded_battle_sprites are a shielded world's (PLANET_SHIELDED: "slaveshield"), whatever its type.
